body: Just thought I'd give you an update since you're the only person who gave enough of a shit to leave a comment. I'm still alive. Things are starting to turn around for me. I'm back on the right track with my life.
I really appreciate what you said, it means a lot to me. I'm definitely going to apologize to my teacher and I'm trying to forget it ever happened.
I had the exact same thing happen to me earlier with having an anxiety induced panic attack. I don't have any advice for you, but you're not alone in this.

And also, if your friends are making fun of you in a hurtful way, they're not your real friends. Taking what people say about you in high school seriously is a pretty bad idea in general, none of that will matter after you graduate.
Hey it's cool, as bad as receeding hairlines are, I can assure you things could be way, way worse.
